{
  "score": 8,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "plugins/agent/build/tests/build-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "DSDIFF-1 and DSDIFF-2 only test the positive case (files_count=0 emits the event); a regression that removed the `\"$files_count\" -eq 0` guard from the elif branch would leave both tests green, because neither test asserts the event is absent when files_count > 0.",
      "quote": "_build_emit_changed_files_summary \"$REPO_DSDIFF1\" \"no_done_sentinel\" \"false\" \"\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "low",
      "message": "DSLOCK-3 redirects stderr into the diff capture with `2>&1`; if git cannot resolve the abbreviated SHA `6a07fa8e` (ambiguous or object absent), the error message is treated as diff output and the assert fires with 'diff is non-empty' rather than indicating the check itself failed.",
      "quote": "_dslock3_diff=\"$(git -C \"$REPO_ROOT\" diff \"${_dslock3_base}..HEAD\" -- \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "low",
      "message": "The DSEND-1 extraction greps all of `route.sh` for `_ROUTE_LOOP_TERMINATED_REASON` assignments, not just those inside `route_to_model_loop`; a value assigned only in another function (e.g. the signal handler at line 1106) would be added to `_required` and force the comment to list a reason `route_to_model_loop` never produces, while the comment is scoped to that one function.",
      "quote": "_route_reasons=\"$(grep -oE '_ROUTE_LOOP_TERMINATED_REASON=\"[a-z_]+\"' \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    }
  ]
}
